bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of text-to-image generation faithfulness and photorealism on the EntityDrawBench dataset, specifically comparing the model's performance discrepancy between frequent and infrequent (long-tail) entities.

Evaluating the model's ability to generate high-fidelity images of rare or unseen entities, such as indigenous foods and landmarks from smaller communities, which standard models typically fail to generate accurately due to under-representation in training data.
